event.description:
Event starts at 6:30, doors open at 6:15 and you can stick around a bit after to talk to community organization/non-profit tables and talk to each other.

Join us for a free community naloxone administration training designed to help prevent opioid overdose deaths and build a safer, healthier community. Participants will learn how to recognize and respond to an overdose, administer naloxone (Narcan®,Padagis®), and connect individuals and families with local recovery resources and supports. Harm reduction saves lives. Through practical strategies such as overdose education, carrying naloxone, using fentanyl test strips, safe medication disposal, and connecting people to support services, we can reduce the risks associated with substance use and create more opportunities for recovery. Every life saved is another chance for treatment, healing, and hope. Participants will learn:

– The basics of opioids, fentanyl, and overdose risk factors.

– How to recognize the signs of an opioid overdose.

– The six-step overdose response plan.

– How to safely administer naloxone.

– Illinois Good Samaritan Law protections

– Local recovery, treatment, and support resources in McLean County.
event.title: Community Narcan (Naloxone) Training with McLean County Recovery Oriented Systems of Care

event.description:
A zine is a little magazine. We make them from one printed sheet with one cut and folding. It's easy, we'll show you. We have had many sessions now of community members coming together to help local education and we have good chats along the way.

These events are hosted by the UUBN Social Justice Team but are run entirely on donations and volunteers and print orders from other groups.

We'll have prints for BloNo Helps Whistle Kits, Shut the Flock Off, Identifying Hate Groups in Central Illinois, and Understanding the Firehose of Falsehood. We have display cases going out around town and distributing them. We may have a new print too?

No cost to attend or to eat, just bring yourself and a pair of favorite scissors if you have them but we have some too and we'll even feed you. Show up and stay for any length of time but we will eat at the end around 6:00 or 6:30. If you're interested in catering one of these let us know! For this we'll have pizza and even some cauliflower crust vegetarian pizza and probably a vegan curry again.

We also tend to have a button press with multiple sizes you, can draw them then and there or bring prints. Although we don't have sign making materials on hand, we're also happy to help you work on protest signs or anything else vaguely within the craftivism realm.

Let us know if you need anything printed or designed too!

UUBN is radically inclusive space and seeks to be accessible for all people. Know that you are welcome and worthy just as you are and if there is anything that can be done to assist your attendance please contact organizers privately or by adding a comment. We value privacy so please no pictures or video.

Linktree for Shut The Flock Off: https://linktr.ee/shuttheflockoffblonomc

Linktree for Central Illinois Iron Front: https://linktr.ee/centralillinoisironfront

Website for UUBN: https://uubn.org
